data: Amazing gameplay amazing artstyle amazing music awesome dialogue perfect length 10/10 game
Adventure, peaceful, funny, charming, beautiful and short are the perfect words to describe this amazing game
Great chill game with fun and engaging quests and amazing soundtrack
This game is amazing, the gameplay is simple and satisfying, the quality of life is great, and I've had a blast doing it 100%
A Short Hike is an excellent cute little adventure that is well worth the time and easily worth full price

The best word to describe this game is delightful.

This game is about the journey and discovery so it's best if I just say it's worth the money and go discover this game for yourself. You won't be disappointed.

Cute and short, a real cozy game. The characters and dialogue are well written. The movement is well implemented. The side quests are low stakes and fun to pursue. Trying to find 100% golden Feathers is fun as you get to really explore every part of the island with maximum mobility. Highly recommend as a game to wind down for the night
Definitely a cute little game to try out if you just want to play a game without reaction times and fatigue.

For the price of a large white monster during the steam summer sale, you can play the greatest bird game ive ever seen

8/10, definitely recommend after a long day
Good game it's something you'll have to come back to every so often. It's Therapeutic

A Short Hike is a game based around walking, climbing, and flying around a very scenic island. There you will meet all sorts of characters who will ask for your help with several tasks. It is incredibly charming.

The main story is quite short, but its emotional punch hits hard and manages to be memorable.

The soundtrack fits the setting perfectly and wins you over.

Finally, The game honors its title and is on the shorter side of things, perfect for a slow afternoon or for winding down after working or studying for the day

Cute. Cozy. Charming. Comforting. Short. Exploring the island was very rewarding and fun. There are too many things to do for such a short game. I can´t be bothered to 100% this one, tho. Not one for fishing minigame collections or real-life-time-locked achievements...
Overall, a nice game to play in one sitting on a weekend.

Beautiful and fun and sweet and endearing. Almost stopped before the motorboat (completed everything else) but glad I didn't because that wound up being my favorite part of the whole game. I could play this all the time it's so comforting.
Such a cute and relaxing game with an animal crossing-esque aesthetic/charm. Lots of fun little activities to do around the island and was super fun to get all the achievements. Well spent money.

This is the most adorable game I’ve played in a while. It saved my soul. I cannot believe there are devs out there who create something this good and put it out for such a cute price tag. Best time to be alive for sure
Great chill game with fun and engaging quests and amazing soundtrack. Well spent few hours!

Superb. This game is short, simple but extremely engaging. It is absolutely worth the price. The story is wonderful, the characters are cute, the music is stellar, and the whole sentiment of the game is one of nostalgia of childhood summer vacations. This is simply one of the best experiences I have ever had. Play this game!

A fun and relaxing game with some good dialogue between your character and NPCs. The game doesn't take too long to finish and the cutscene once you reach the top is worth any time you sink into the story. On top of the main climb there's a bunch of quests to do and a handful of achievements to get, all of which are quick and fun. I managed to beat the game more or less 100% in around 6 and half hours.

This game is certainly a special one, and at a brilliant price as well.

I enjoyed my time with this game. It's a fun game where you get to expole an island, you climb, fly, glide and walk around this island and talk to the inhabitans while solving a few quests. It's a casual game with really nice atmospheric audio track. Relaxing and fun.

A great game of exploration with a couple of minigames inside. Try yourself at parkour and fishing, look for hidden treasure and secret passages, complete small and simple quests and enjoy the picturesque view! Travel around the island, listen to the stories of the different animals - travelers, sportsmen, sailors and others. I really liked the friendly and motivational tone of the many dialogues in this game. It is a wonderful proof that you CAN make a good game without drama and major conflicts.

The only downside for me is the questionable idea of making this game look "pixelated". Considering it a full 3D-game with a camera that flies around a lot, this "pixelating filter" is a nuisance. But my eyes have accustomed to the visual style in several minutes.

A jolly fun game where you go on a short hike, the dialogue is superb as is the art and gameplay

Also make sure to run during the Volley Ball Game, that helps a lot

What a nice day for a hike.

Game is cute! and there is flying! and fishing and cute animal creatures to talk to 10/10 if you like exploration games.
Legit game. Relaxed pace, goofy characters, and pleasant graphics. There are still some challenges and the map is fun to explore.

All of the joys and wonders of a short hike with none of the sore feet.
Also the people are arguably way nicer.
And there are banging hats.

♥
I didn't expect to be so engrossed by this game, yet here we are. It scratches that exploration itch in a way that many games wish they could.

A Short Hike is, as the name suggests, a little exploration adventure on a small colorful island!
You are a little bird making your way to the summit of the mountain in the centre while exploring the many locations around it and meeting other cute animals. The game is the perfect comfort zone you sometimes wish for!
The gameplay is simple but i still recommend to play this game with a controller!
8/10
This game has it all; Gliding, racing, boat drifting, fishing, parkour, treasure hunt, and teaching moral values. 10/10 would like to experience it again in another lifetime.
A bright, beautiful, wholesome feeling Pixelgame. giving me some serious NES era vibes. Super chill, good soundtrack, clear vision.
Will probably take you under 2 hr to finish, but was one of the best 2 hr spent playing a game

I saw the trailer several times on Twitter, and each time, it intrigued me, as I'm a huge fan of character-driven, atmospheric games.
'A Short Hike' doesn't disappoint. Hawk Peak is a vibrant, lush place to explore, full of colourful characters, masterfully rendered set pieces, and a great helping of hidden collectables. Despite its generally chill pacing, there are some fairly challenging elements that will appeal to a completionist-I'm still missing one ingenious secret achievement that I'd never have considered without the help of a guide.
The soundtrack is ambient, calming, and fits each location perfectly. The art style is a delightful fusion of retro and modern. Though the narrative is somewhat sparse, it's clear that this is a game that encourages players to spend as much time as they like, immersing themselves in the meticulously crafted setting. It's a game in which the experience is a reward in itself.
The fact that I played for two solid hours without saving, had my computer crash, and then immediately picked it back up to spend another hour regaining all of my progress should say enough.

'A Short Hike' is the lovechild of 'Journey' and 'Night in the Woods' that I didn't know I needed until now.

Really straightforward, lovable game. The barriers you have to overcome are fair and achievable for players of all abilities. The dialogue is engaging and the story is relatable and rewarding. This game left me feeling happy and satisfied and I recommend it to everyone.
super calm and chill although it is around 10 hours of playtime if ur 100%ing it, so not a very long game
As of writing this, my any% time is 1 minutes and 36 seconds. The title does not lie, this is a short hike.
A beautiful, life-affirming game, jam-packed with discovery and adventure. And it achieved that all in just a few short hours.
A cute and chill game from beginning to end. Enjoyed every minute of exploring the island and getting to know all the characters you meet along the way.

Very relaxing game. Much needed break after binge playing FPS titles. If you focus solely on the main objective with "A Short Hike" you'll find that the game may only offer about one hour of game play. However, there are multiple side activities that you can engage in such as fishing, exploring, collecting items, and of course, beachstickball.

This adorable little adventure held my attention for a mere hour, but that hour I spent playing the game was the most charming experience I've ever had playing such a simple video game. I cannot put into words just how real every character feels in this game, and I cannot begin to describe the immense satisfaction that comes from learning how to use the few basic mechanics this game presents to their maximum potential.

The pixelated 3D artstyle is certainly quite enticing. This is a great game to relax with, whether coming home from work, cooling down from an intense game match, or just to relieve some stress. Characters and story are also endearing, being well-written. This is worth the asking price, especially on sale.

a short game (1 to 2 hours to "beat", or 3 to 4h for 100%), super cute, great soundtrack, great visuals and great storytelling.
very nice.

This game was a simple, yet charming! The ambiance, characters, and scenery all made for a short but sweet experience that, in the end, made me feel something indescribable. Take an open night to play this game! You won't regret it!

Fantastic little game! Took my about 3.5 hours to play through, but I could definitely see revisiting this one again in the future. Calming, casual, almost zen-like gameplay with colorful characters, beautiful scenery, charming soundtrack, and an overall calming experience.
It's wholesome, cozy, funny, has a completely explorable map and gives strong autumn vibes. Worth every penny.

Excellent beautiful game

Game is naturally casual and a relaxing experience. It's not too long, but can get a bit longer doing side stuff, even things that are not like "given quests" but you can do / explore / discover (like rare fishing variants for every fish, hidden unmarked digging spots, treasure maps, trash island xD)
Everything about the experience just feels right, music, progression, the simple yet impactful message of the journey. I loved it from start to finish, there is beauty, simplicity and art on this incredible ride of a game
At the right time, you can eat a Toast!
You'll even learn a brand new sport that's gonna be the next big thing! =D
Fishing is also very satisfying (there's no shame in falling into the water while learning!)
And you can even boat race challenge =o
Although my personal fav might just be hearing about the Boulder Books Saga, hands down

There's no reason NOT to get this game :)
amazing game for the price, lots of non-repetitive content, lots of side stories that are interesting, and it just feel amazing to discover the mountain without any direct restriction.
Super chill and relaxing. If you can't actually go hiking outside it's a pretty decent substitute.

Probably one of the best-designed indie games of this generation. What a refreshing and wonderful experience. For folks used to games with high budgets the graphics could look a little too pixelated at first, but you will find the open world in this game more interactive and vivid than most of the worlds in those triple-A titles on the market. There's a ton of places to explore, the characters are lovable and the 3D platforming gameplay is fun. Also, there's an incredible amount of nostalgia in this game, and I absolutely loved how the devs blended the exploration elements from breath of the wild with the coziness of animal crossing to build this immersive world full of details and surprises. The game didn't take too long to finish but every minute was worth it. I can't help writing this review because this game deserves more attention. Just buy it and play it.

Just a really simple and beautiful game. You could probably finish the main part in less than an hour, but the game's charm just keeps drawing you back in, and you can really tell the passion that went into every single part. Everything from the art, to the soundtrack, to its simplicity and every little detail you find is stunning and seeping of the team's hard work and creativity. I think of this game more of a piece of art to appreciate rather than a super engaging game, and its a must play for anyone looking for a little escape from everyday life!! This game means a lot to me and I hope you as well find a little joy from it :D

Absolutely incredible.

The visual style of this game is so simple and charming, I love it. The music is atmospheric and gets better the more you play. While it is a short game, there is so much to do around the island, I found myself constantly sidetracked from the main goal, whether that be collecting coins or talking to a character I haven't seen before, but that was a good thing because all the characters and activities scattered throughout the game are pleasant and make me want to explore more and see what else is packed into this game. I never found myself getting annoyed at anything and I had no issues with the controls. Everything just feels like it was made with passion.

Cannot recommend enough, I love this game.
Amazing game. Very cute, fun, and sentimental. It was fun exploring the island and getting to know all the characters. I would recommend this game to everyone.
Great! I really enjoyed it. The move set is really fun and that makes exploring a treat.

This is such a charming game. No stress, just fun exploration and world. While short, it is worth you time. Just enjoy the experience. Especially enjoyed as a nice end to a session of difficult games to bring you back down

A charming and heart-warming game that's basically exploring the world and interacting with the people of Hawk Peak Provincial Park. Its fun to complete to a 100% once you are done with the main story too, but it doesn't take more than 3 hours for most people.

Its a great change of phase from all the games steam has to offer, i recommend it to everyone that likes these calming experiences, plus its very cheap on sales!

This was fine - I think it had been a bit overhyped for me, and I was expecting something with a bit more spark to it, but it is a really solid experience and a nice game you can 100% in around 5 hours. I have no real complaints, but it hasn't left a mark, either.
